blind_spots.operator_reality: 'SBOMs should be generated continuously... real-time SBOM monitoring' assumes constant connectivity to Manifest's cloud backend — the same failure mode as the 30fps crowd-detection case if the systems it's meant to secure sit on a disconnected tactical network.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team is building enterprise SaaS for connected corporate/HQ security teams, not tactical-edge deployment.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: SBOMs should be generated continuously, not just when a product is released. Manifest supports real-time SBOM monitoring, enrichment, and vulnerability tracking

blind_spots.blind_spot: No articulation of the product's own path to an ATO/RMF authorization on government networks, despite naming Defense & Gov't as a core vertical and running DOD CIO pilots.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Four DOD pilots (2024) risk the classic valley-of-death outcome: they never convert to production because the tool itself lacks a stated path to run on the actual IL4/IL5 network it's meant to protect.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Language centers on customers' compliance frameworks (EO 14028, NIST 800-218) rather than the vendor's own network authorization.
